tufts-hsa-liquid.identity: Doxorubicin plus mutation-guided oral inhibitors and ctDNA monitoring for newly diagnosed splenic HSA.
tufts-hsa-liquid.recruitment_sites: Current individual Tufts Recruiting protocol, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton MA.
tufts-hsa-liquid.eligibility: Dogs ≥10 kg, splenic HSA without apparent extra-splenic spread, no previous HSA therapy, no serious heart/lung/kidney/liver disease. Recent outside splenectomy may qualify with histopathology.
tufts-hsa-liquid.funding: Up to $5,000 for HSA treatment; oral inhibitor and treatment-related adverse care funded. No unrelated care or separate promised splenectomy reimbursement.
tufts-hsa-liquid.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; follow-up or day of treatment is not a cutoff.

tufts-z007-broad-solid-2026.identity: Intratumoral or IV innate immune TLR agonist Z-007 in broad solid tumors, separate from Illinois pulmonary OSA protocol.
tufts-z007-broad-solid-2026.recruitment_sites: Current individual Tufts Recruiting protocol, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton MA.
tufts-z007-broad-solid-2026.eligibility: Dog ≥7 kg, repeat-biopsy accessible solid tumor 2–7 cm, expected survival ≥8 weeks; untreated or failed standard therapy, no previous immunotherapy, autoimmune history, significant organ illness or count abnormalities. Metastasis permitted.
tufts-z007-broad-solid-2026.funding: Treatment with Z-007 through day 63 and adverse care from Z-007/biopsy covered; continued visits and routine bloodwork after day 63, unrelated care owner-paid.
tufts-z007-broad-solid-2026.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; follow-up or day of treatment is not a cutoff.

tufts-met-osa-vaccine-tme.identity: Tumor-microenvironment oral immune modulation and allogeneic cancer vaccine after progression to lungs.
tufts-met-osa-vaccine-tme.recruitment_sites: Current individual Tufts Recruiting protocol, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton MA.
tufts-met-osa-vaccine-tme.eligibility: Canine OSA after amputation and chemotherapy before lung metastasis; clinically well, no major heart/kidney/liver disease.
tufts-met-osa-vaccine-tme.funding: Oral drugs, vaccines and nearly all planned visits/x-rays/labs covered. Week 4/12/20 bloodwork about $250 each; some side effect medications/unrelated care owner-paid.
tufts-met-osa-vaccine-tme.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; follow-up or day of treatment is not a cutoff.

tufts-osa-actionable-targets-2026.identity: Olaparib, temozolomide or VLS-1488, pre/post amputation or metastatic disease after failure.
tufts-osa-actionable-targets-2026.recruitment_sites: Current individual Tufts Recruiting protocol, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton MA.
tufts-osa-actionable-targets-2026.eligibility: Dog ≥15 kg; Group A presumptive limb OSA without spread and preamputation; Group B prior amputation plus carboplatin/study drug, specified lung/skin/subcutis/abdominal metastases and no bone metastasis, expected life ≥1 month. Both require adequate lab/organ status and no conflicting small molecules.
tufts-osa-actionable-targets-2026.funding: Study screening covered; $1,500 amputation credit where applicable, post-amputation study therapy and related adverse care covered; unrelated conditions owner-paid.
tufts-osa-actionable-targets-2026.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; follow-up or day of treatment is not a cutoff.

tufts-sabr-pulmonary-metastases-2026.identity: Single fraction SABR for selected progressive pulmonary oligometastatic canine malignancy; distinct from localized primary lung SBRT.
tufts-sabr-pulmonary-metastases-2026.recruitment_sites: Current individual Tufts Recruiting protocol, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton MA.
tufts-sabr-pulmonary-metastases-2026.eligibility: Cytology/histology-confirmed malignancy and 2–10 lung metastases, progression on chest imaging over ≥6–8 weeks; control of primary/other disease, no malignant effusion and fit for anesthesia/RT.
tufts-sabr-pulmonary-metastases-2026.funding: Pre-enrollment labs, imaging/planning CT and diagnosis owner-paid; study RT, month-one recheck and up to $860 for later CT covered as published.
tufts-sabr-pulmonary-metastases-2026.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; follow-up or day of treatment is not a cutoff.

eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.identity: Randomized ICG vs Angiostamp fluorescence-guided removal of canine brachial/lumbar plexus nerve-sheath tumors, distinct PNST-specific cohort within ZH026/2023.
eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.recruitment_sites: Official Zurich named study explicitly open to participation, University of Zurich Veterinary Hospital.
eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.eligibility: Dogs with planned surgery and MRI/CT-suspected brachial/lumbar plexus tumor. Cytology helpful but not mandatory.
eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.funding: Study dye supplied without charge, surgery/staging costs not itemized.
eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.contacts: Zurich official study contact form; Nolff/Beer/Beckmann.
eu-ch-pnst-plexus-fluorescence-surgery.deadline: No published recruitment date or cutoff; target N=40 is not date.

ch-zurich-sts-fluorescence-guided-surger.identity: Randomized ICG vs Angiostamp therapeutic tumor removal for general soft-tissue sarcoma; same ethics umbrella as PNST but distinct cohort/disease scope.
ch-zurich-sts-fluorescence-guided-surger.recruitment_sites: Official individual open protocol at Zurich Veterinary Hospital.
ch-zurich-sts-fluorescence-guided-surger.eligibility: Dog or cat with confirmed STS requiring surgery or re-excision after incomplete margins; no severe heart/renal disease precluding anesthesia; mild controlled disease allowed.
ch-zurich-sts-fluorescence-guided-surger.funding: Study covers main part of surgery under SNF funding, percentage and other fees not itemized.
ch-zurich-sts-fluorescence-guided-surger.contacts: Zurich official study contact form; Mirja Nolff and Patricia Beer.

ch-zurich-canine-high-grade-glioma-chemo.identity: Randomized temozolomide and lomustine vs placebo; all dogs receive RT for high-grade glioma.
ch-zurich-canine-high-grade-glioma-chemo.recruitment_sites: Current official Zurich protocol open to participation and independent English owner PDF, one University of Zurich Veterinary Hospital.
ch-zurich-canine-high-grade-glioma-chemo.eligibility: MRI suspicion screened with minimal invasive biopsy; high-grade glioma confirmed before treatment, acceptable marrow/renal/liver function; no major incompatible illnesses.
ch-zurich-canine-high-grade-glioma-chemo.funding: Biopsy, chemotherapy and labs free; RT discounted; check final individualized expense.
ch-zurich-canine-high-grade-glioma-chemo.deadline: No dated recruitment cutoff; PDF document publication and study follow-up are separate.

ch-zurich-canine-meningioma-genomic-rt.identity: Treatment access with ten sessions of standard RT and genomic analysis of biopsy; research compares predictors, not two investigational treatment arms.
ch-zurich-canine-meningioma-genomic-rt.recruitment_sites: Official open Zurich individual study, Zurich Veterinary Hospital.
ch-zurich-canine-meningioma-genomic-rt.eligibility: Canine meningioma suspected on MRI, eligible for anesthesia and protocol assessment including biopsy.
ch-zurich-canine-meningioma-genomic-rt.funding: MRI and biopsy provided free, follow-up discounted. RT charge not itemized in current named page; do not call it free.

jp-tokyo-organoid-guided-targeted-therap.identity: Administers an oral personalized targeted drug selected from tumor organoid screen; not diagnostic-only.
jp-tokyo-organoid-guided-targeted-therap.recruitment_sites: Current named individual section on official Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center research page, Bunkyo, Tokyo.
jp-tokyo-organoid-guided-targeted-therap.eligibility: Dogs/cats with metastatic or invasive solid tumor lacking curative standard therapy; promising screened drug and agreement to lesion sampling/visits weeks 1,3,5; not lymphoma or leukemia.
jp-tokyo-organoid-guided-targeted-therap.funding: Study drug free; biopsy/screening and other care costs not published.
jp-tokyo-organoid-guided-targeted-therap.deadline: No published intake cutoff; named historical ethics approval is not a recruitment date.

jp-tokyo-canine-bladder-ido1-inhibitor.identity: Oral IDO1 inhibitor twice daily for canine bladder carcinoma, distinct from lapatinib and VSEC anti-CCR4 combination.
jp-tokyo-canine-bladder-ido1-inhibitor.recruitment_sites: Current named individual section on official Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center research page, Bunkyo, Tokyo.
jp-tokyo-canine-bladder-ido1-inhibitor.eligibility: Dogs with bladder cancer; suspected cases may present for screening. Tissue sampling and Tokyo visits at weeks 1, 3, 5.
jp-tokyo-canine-bladder-ido1-inhibitor.funding: Study drug free; other owner costs not specified.
jp-tokyo-canine-bladder-ido1-inhibitor.deadline: No published intake cutoff; named historical ethics approval is not a recruitment date.

jp-tokyo-macromolecular-pirarubicin-soli.identity: IV polymer-conjugated pirarubicin every two weeks.
jp-tokyo-macromolecular-pirarubicin-soli.recruitment_sites: Current named individual section on official Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center research page, Bunkyo, Tokyo.
jp-tokyo-macromolecular-pirarubicin-soli.eligibility: Canine unresectable or metastatic malignant solid tumors without effective standard treatment; agree to lesion sampling and visits every 1–2 weeks.
jp-tokyo-macromolecular-pirarubicin-soli.funding: Study drug free; other care/testing costs not published.
jp-tokyo-macromolecular-pirarubicin-soli.deadline: No published intake cutoff; named historical ethics approval is not a recruitment date.

jp-tokyo-histiocytic-sarcoma-anti-pd1-20.identity: Canine-specific investigational IV anti-PD-1 every two weeks for histiocytic sarcoma, separate from oral melanoma multicenter trial.
jp-tokyo-histiocytic-sarcoma-anti-pd1-20.recruitment_sites: Current named individual section on official Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center research page, Bunkyo, Tokyo.
jp-tokyo-histiocytic-sarcoma-anti-pd1-20.eligibility: Tokyo biopsy confirmed HS and a detectable lesion remains; no immunosuppression or immunotherapy; recurring visits; large dogs may be restricted without a public numeric limit.
jp-tokyo-histiocytic-sarcoma-anti-pd1-20.funding: Published individual Tokyo section gives no study versus owner cost terms.
jp-tokyo-histiocytic-sarcoma-anti-pd1-20.deadline: No published intake cutoff; named historical ethics approval is not a recruitment date.

jp-tottori-pdt.identity: Tottori investigational photosensitizer followed by wavelength-specific laser/LED PDT for accessible disease; prior publications are contextual only.
jp-tottori-pdt.recruitment_sites: Current named case-consultation and intervention at Tottori University veterinary medical center only.
jp-tottori-pdt.eligibility: Dogs/cats principally with body surface, nasal cavity or bladder tumors and ability to return; eligibility depends on case, no other detailed published restrictions.
jp-tottori-pdt.funding: Current primary does not publish treatment, imaging or follow-up cost terms.
jp-tottori-pdt.contacts: Tomohiro Osaki tosaki@tottori-u.ac.jp, through Tottori clinical research program.

jp-vsec-ucc-mogamulizumab-radiation.identity: VSEC 3:2 mogamulizumab vs saline/placebo with firocoxib and radiation in both arms; three infusions q4 weeks.
jp-vsec-ucc-mogamulizumab-radiation.recruitment_sites: Current VSEC case-specific treatment section in Saitama; Tokyo collaborators are not independently published sites.
jp-vsec-ucc-mogamulizumab-radiation.eligibility: Dog suspected or confirmed lower urinary tract UCC; no prior cancer therapy or surgery, urinary obstruction/hydronephrosis/hydroureter, IRIS 3–4 CKD, or poor expected survival <2–3 months.
jp-vsec-ucc-mogamulizumab-radiation.funding: Costs for study drug, radiation, routine care and follow-up not published.
jp-vsec-ucc-mogamulizumab-radiation.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; 12 weeks is participation.

jp-nvlu-survivin-peptide-vaccine-2026.identity: Disease-specific survivin peptide vaccine at Nippon Veterinary and Life Science University, with leukocyte type compatibility investigation.
jp-nvlu-survivin-peptide-vaccine-2026.recruitment_sites: Current NVLU numbered clinical research protocol, single Musashino Tokyo site.
jp-nvlu-survivin-peptide-vaccine-2026.eligibility: Canine cancer, survivin expression ideally confirmed; unknown expression when sampling difficult may require necropsy consent. Treatment, recurrence prevention or difficult recurrent disease described.
jp-nvlu-survivin-peptide-vaccine-2026.funding: Current primary does not publish owner costs or subsidies.
jp-nvlu-survivin-peptide-vaccine-2026.deadline: Official current index lists study period through 2027-03-31; no separate enrollment date in individual notice. Retain approved study-end policy and original evidence.

jp-hokkaido-canine-oral-melanoma-anti-pd.identity: Hokkaido therapeutic canine anti-PD-L1 antibody, distinctly not the three-site Nippon Zenyaku anti-PD-1 study.
jp-hokkaido-canine-oral-melanoma-anti-pd.recruitment_sites: Current Hokkaido University VTH page explicitly solicits patients; one Sapporo recruiting site.
jp-hokkaido-canine-oral-melanoma-anti-pd.eligibility: Named canonical cohort oral malignant melanoma with lung metastases; broader cancers not mapped from introductory wording. Regular clinic safety/efficacy assessments; remaining criteria unpublished.
jp-hokkaido-canine-oral-melanoma-anti-pd.funding: Official protocol does not publish treatment, screening or follow-up coverage.
jp-hokkaido-canine-oral-melanoma-anti-pd.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; linked 2017–2023 reports are not current dates.

ucd-pdl1-metastatic.identity: CAALM IACUC 24060/VCCT-24-012 novel UCD-PDL1 up to six infusions every two weeks.
ucd-pdl1-metastatic.recruitment_sites: Current official UC Davis StudyPages case invitation and UC Davis native gallery; UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital.
ucd-pdl1-metastatic.eligibility: Dog >15 and <36 kg with cytology/biopsy-confirmed oral melanoma and ≥1 lung metastasis; no recent chemo, immunotherapy or steroids within two weeks and no uncontrolled illness.
ucd-pdl1-metastatic.funding: Study infusion, required tests/imaging and up to $2,000 for protocol adverse events; study enrollment expenses distinct from pre-enrollment care.
ucd-pdl1-metastatic.deadline: Official 2025-01-27 through 2027-09-10; 98 days individual study duration.

ucd-oral-margin.identity: VCCT-26-008 IACUC 24708 therapeutic anti-PDL1 bound to IRDye800 twice before surgical margin assessment, also assesses local antitumor immune response.
ucd-oral-margin.recruitment_sites: Current official UC Davis StudyPages study and gallery, Davis veterinary hospital.
ucd-oral-margin.eligibility: Confirmed oral SCC or OMM, healthy for anesthesia and repeat visits and study biopsy; pediatric threshold in canonical prior primary evidence.
ucd-oral-margin.funding: Biopsy and study-related additional hospitalization covered; $1,500 toward therapy. Owner pays remainder of screening, workup and treatment.

csu-brain-cart-verdinexor.identity: CSU IACUC 5335 two autologous CAR-T treatments with verdinexor and optional radiation, distinct from oral-only IACUC 6276.
csu-brain-cart-verdinexor.recruitment_sites: Current CSU exact page and native 23708, one Fort Collins site.
csu-brain-cart-verdinexor.eligibility: Canine MRI glioma, >10 lb, no prior chemotherapy/RT, fit for anesthesia and home oral therapy.
csu-brain-cart-verdinexor.funding: Study treatment including optional RT, recheck MRI, labs and lifetime verdinexor covered as published; no transfer to separate oral-only protocol.
csu-brain-cart-verdinexor.deadline: Exact current end 2028-12-31; five months is individual duration.

csu-osa-3d-limb-spare.identity: CSU IACUC 6218 patient-specific 3D implant, limb-sparing surgery and six cycles of chemotherapy.
csu-osa-3d-limb-spare.recruitment_sites: Current CSU official program and exact patient page, Fort Collins.
csu-osa-3d-limb-spare.eligibility: Suspected/confirmed distal-radius OSA, giant breed OR ≥40 kg, surgery candidate, no metastases or immune-modulating drugs.
csu-osa-3d-limb-spare.funding: Study PET-CT/anesthesia, implant, surgery/hospitalization, chemo and up to 20mo follow-up covered; up to $5,825 for surgical complications, pre-entry tests/outside care owner-paid.
csu-osa-3d-limb-spare.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; 20 months is follow-up.

csu-ucc-lapatinib-rt.identity: CSU IACUC 7191 lapatinib and NSAID with fractionated radiotherapy for biopsy-confirmed bladder TCC.
csu-ucc-lapatinib-rt.recruitment_sites: Current CSU exact participant protocol, all visits Fort Collins.
csu-ucc-lapatinib-rt.eligibility: Dog with biopsy-proven bladder TCC, fit for repeat anesthesia and NSAID, no RT in last six weeks/chemo in last two.
csu-ucc-lapatinib-rt.funding: Lapatinib, recheck exams/labs, baseline/end US and sedation covered; $3,000 RT support; owner pays diagnosis/NSAID/RT balance. Some adverse event assistance.
csu-ucc-lapatinib-rt.deadline: No recruitment deadline. Exact daily radiation calendar in published prose inconsistent and not changed.
